sections.title: Contributors to population change in Sedgemoor
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Sedgemoor, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 4,306 people (−3.4%). In total, there were 10,835 births and 15,140 deaths in Sedgemoor between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 11,106 (8.8%). There were 65,588 people entering the area and 54,482 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Sedgemoor of 537 people (−0.4%), as a result of 3,681 people entering the area and 4,218 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Sedgemoor's population of 1,445 (1.1%).as a result of 5,386 people entering the area and 3,941 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
